{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float
# Remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders
# Only completed orders count for conversion rate
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Filter out QA orders: revenue = 999999.99
# There are 6 such rows
df_clean = df_completed[df_completed['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Verify QA orders are removed
print(f"Number of QA orders in clean data: {len(df_clean[df_clean['revenue'] == 999999.99])}")

# Now compute conversion rate by channel, unadjusted
conversion_rate_email = df_clean[df_clean['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
conversion_rate_paid_search = df_clean[df_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()
unadjusted_diff = conversion_rate_email - conversion_rate_paid_search

# Now compute adjusted conversion rates by segment
# First, compute conversion rate for each channel within each segment
segment_channel_conv = df_clean.groupby(['customer_segment', 'channel'])['converted'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Compute difference within each segment, then average
segment_diffs = []
for seg in df_clean['customer_segment'].unique():
    seg_data = df_clean[df_clean['customer_segment'] == seg]
    if len(seg_data) < 2:  # Skip if only one channel present
        continue
    conv_email = seg_data[seg_data['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
    conv_paid = seg_data[seg_data['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()
    diff = conv_email - conv_paid
    segment_diffs.append(diff)

# Average the differences across segments
adjusted_diff = sum(segment_diffs) / len(segment_diffs)

# Print results
print(f"Clean data size: {len(df_clean)}")
print(f"Unadjusted difference (email - paid_search): {unadjusted_diff:.4f}")
print(f"Adjusted difference (stratified): {adjusted_diff:.4f}")
print(f"Conversion rate email: {conversion_rate_email:.4f}")
print(f"Conversion rate paid_search: {conversion_rate_paid_search:.4f}")
print(f"Segment-level conversion rates:\n{segment_channel_conv}")

# Check segment distribution
channel_segment_dist = df_clean.groupby('channel')['customer_segment'].value_counts(normalize=True)
print(f"Channel-wise segment distribution:\n{channel_segment_dist}")"}
